title: neoancistrophyllum secundiflorum
intro: Neoancistrophyllum secundiflorum, commonly known as the "Kadupul flower" or "Queen of the Night," is a rare and exotic flowering plant species native to Sri Lanka. This plant is known for its unique ability to bloom only at night and wilt by morning, making it a highly sought-after species. The Kadupul flower has been traditionally used in Sri Lankan medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and respiratory problems, due to its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of Neoancistrophyllum secundiflorum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
